description: This file defines the CompilationResult class in the ScssPhp project, encapsulating the result of compiling SCSS into CSS, including CSS output, source map, and included files.

classes.name: CompilationResult
classes.description: Represents the result of an SCSS compilation, containing CSS output, optional source map, and included files.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a CompilationResult with CSS content, optional source map, and list of included files.

methods.name: getIncludedFiles
methods.description: Returns the list of included files.

methods.name: getSourceMap
methods.description: Returns the source map content if available, or null.
